title: McKinnon on why he scanned US military networks
summary: Gary McKinnon tells of McKinnon on why he scanned US military networks, about 2002-2003 at UK / US military networks, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I read the disclosure project book Steven Greer and his team.

plain: Gary McKinnon is a British man who, around 2002 and 2003, searched through US military computer networks from the UK. On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, he says he did it after reading a book from the Disclosure Project. That is a group led by Steven Greer that collects testimony from people who say the government hides what it knows about UFOs. As McKinnon tells it, he was looking for proof that such secrets were sitting on military computers.
